notes:
Promotions: a new Promotions screen lets HR, CEO/MD and Super Admin give an employee a new designation and department. The employee gets a notification and an email with the promotion letter.

Salary revisions: once a salary change is approved, the employee gets a notification and an email with the increment letter. Letters open from the Salary Revisions screen, which has a new look.

Dropdowns: a new designation or department can be added straight from the search box.
